Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly proposed treating Universal Music Group (the distributor) as the parent company of Apple Records and even suggested finalizing the answer with UMG. This conflated distribution with ownership; in reality, Apple Records is part of Apple Corps. Although later corrected, this was the first clear factual error leading toward the wrong solution.
